articleBody:
Getting your business recognized and recommended by AI isn't just about having great content; it's about being a trusted 'entity'. AI systems are looking for consistency and clarity across all your digital touchpoints. Here's a checklist to see if your business is set up for AI trust:

- [ ] Canonical Business Name Established — why it matters: AI needs a single, unambiguous name to identify your business across the web, reducing confusion and bolstering its ability to link disparate information to you.
- [ ] Consistent Business Name Across All Platforms — why it matters: Any variation in your business name (e.g., "LLC" vs. "Inc.") on social media, directories, and your website can confuse AI, making it less likely to trust and cite your entity.
- [ ] Official Website URL Consistently Used — why it matters: A clear, consistent website URL across all your online presences helps AI understand the authoritative source for your business information and directs users correctly.
- [ ] About/Contact Page Enhanced with Key Entity Details — why it matters: These pages provide AI with essential, structured information about who you are, what you do, and how to reach you, forming the core of your entity profile.
- [ ] Organization/LocalBusiness Schema Applied — why it matters: Rich schema markup directly tells AI systems critical facts about your business, such as its name, address, phone number, and type, in a machine-readable format.
- [ ] Official Profiles (e.g., Google Business Profile) Linked and Verified — why it matters: Connecting your website to verified external profiles reinforces your legitimacy and provides AI with additional trusted sources for validating your entity.
- [ ] Service Areas Clearly Defined — why it matters: For local businesses, precise service area information helps AI match your offerings to location-based queries, ensuring you appear in relevant local AI-generated answers.
- [ ] Team Members Listed with Schema (if applicable) — why it matters: Highlighting the people behind your business helps AI build a more complete and trustworthy entity profile, especially for service-based businesses.

How to use this checklist: Go through each item and honestly assess your business's current state. If you find any gaps or inconsistencies, prioritize addressing them. A strong entity profile is foundational for AI discovery and citation, making your business more likely to be recommended.
